Fix serious errors:
When consumers are unable to move to their seats, the game cannot be played. If this issue occurs, please delete the old version of the save file. 
The savefile path is: C:\Users\yourname\AppData\LocalLow\LAEStudio\Hottie Sweetie\HSSaveFile
